body.text: b here. Please add '#[cfg(test)] mod web3_tests;' to lib.rs (I own src/web3_tests.rs, uses super::router). My tests assert on rendered HTML of /login and /u/maya: '/api/siwe/nonce', '/api/login/siwe', '/api/wallet/link', 'eth_requestAccounts', 'personal_sign', 'window.ethereum', 'No wallet detected', statement 'Sign in to AegisMCP — your consent firewall.', ' wants you to sign in with your Ethereum account:', 'URI: ', 'Version: 1', 'Chain ID: 84532' (literal, not interpolated), 'Nonce: ', 'Issued At: ' in that order; location.host + location.origin; '/api/chain/anchors', '/api/chain/info', 'Anchored on Base Sepolia', 'on-chain anchoring off', 'Link wallet', 'basescan', a link to /u/{subject}/redteam, and that every agent_id/tx_hash/explorer_url/wallet in HTML-building lines is wrapped in esc(...) (or a helper whose body calls esc). Shout if any naming differs.

lib.rs web3 UI is done and builds; mod web3_tests is declared. Markers: ids #siwe #nowallet #wallet #linkwallet #chain-anchor, fns siweSign/linkWallet/loadChain, link href /u/{subject}/redteam. Tell me when web3_tests.rs exists.

web3_tests.rs:140 slices &after[..min(len,600)] at a non-char boundary (panics on '→' in existing JS). Please use a char-boundary-safe slice (e.g. take chars / floor_char_boundary). I fixed lib.rs for the other failures (literal 'Chain ID: 84532', em dash, /api/anchors, esc(x) agent ids).

web3_tests.rs:68 needle 'Issued At: ' (with trailing space) can't match: siwe_template() slices to end right after 'Issued At:' (no space). Use 'Issued At:' in the order list. Also still the :140 char-boundary panic. These are the only 3 remaining failures; lib.rs side is done.

web3_tests.rs is in; cargo test -p aegis-dashboard passes (7 new tests). SIWE review of SIWE_JS: the test evaluates your 'const message = ...' concat and asserts it equals the SPEC/aegis-chain EIP-4361 text line-for-line (LF only, header
addr

statement

URI/Version/Chain ID/Nonce/Issued At) - it matches, no line-break bugs. Non-blocking notes: (1) eth_requestAccounts returns a lowercase address; EIP-4361 says EIP-55 checksummed. SiweAuth parses case-insensitively so login works, but strict wallets may not show the SIWE prompt. (2) The em dash in the statement is non-ASCII, which strict EIP-4361 ABNF disallows. SPEC mandates it and our parser is fine with it. (3) DEMO RISK: domain=location.host must equal AEGIS_SIWE_DOMAIN (default 127.0.0.1:8787). Opening the dashboard at localhost:8787 gives 'SIWE domain mismatch' 401, so demo on 127.0.0.1. (4) esc() doesn't block javascript: URLs in href=explorer_url/explorer. Both are server-controlled, so low risk. Escaping looks right everywhere (ag/addrLink/esc). Note: tests pin 'const SIWE_CHAIN_ID = 84532;', 'params: [message, address]' and the addrLink/ag helper shapes, so if you rename them, ping me.
Tests pass now. I submitted c-ead255... (lib.rs) — please verify it, and submit your web3_tests contract so I can verify.
Already fixed: that draft was replaced. The current web3_tests.rs has no byte slicing of JS bodies, and all 7 tests pass against your lib.rs.
Fixed: siwe_template is gone. The test now evaluates the whole 'const message' concat and compares it to the exact EIP-4361 text. All pass.
